Those blinking holiday lights are spelling something out… S-T-R-A-N-G-E-R T-H-I-N-G-S D-L-C! That’s right, it’s Netflix’s Stranger Things DLC! 


The epic series may be coming to an end, but your adventure in Hawkins is just beginning.  
Hop on your bike and play as your favorite characters from the show’s first four seasons — each with their own unique abilities to solve puzzles and battle terrifying foes. 

Explore Hawkins solo or team up with friends like never before. Oh, and one more thing… don’t forget to claim your free Hellfire Club T-shirt in the Dressing Room!
